title: eat shit & die 155
author: bpatrick
body: I’ve been working on this one for over a month. I don’t know why it took so long. It doesn’t look like it took that long. I am happy it’s got Allison’s brother Spencer Kelly. I’ve got a bunch of stories in mind for him.
